text:
A: Hiya! Can you hear me? I'm Gemma, Beeston, near Nottingham.
B: Hi, yes. I'm Klára, in Walthamstow. In London.
A: Oh, I loved your photo, the little dinosaur on the sofa. How old is he?
B: Three and a half. Matěj. Dinosaurs are everything now. I know more about the T. rex than I ever wanted.
A: (laughs) Honestly, that's adorable. And you saw my dog bed, I bet. Biscuit, the cockapoo.
B: Yes, I heard about Biscuit. Craig told me. He has a Biscuit too.
A: Everyone has a Biscuit! I think there's three now. So are you at home with him full-time?
B: At the moment, yes. Before, I worked in a department store, on the customer desk. I'd like to go back part-time, maybe reception, a GP surgery or a school office.
A: Oh, you'd be brilliant on reception. I can just tell, you've got a calm face. Our receptionists at work are the ones who actually run the place, do you know what I mean? The patients shout at them, not at us.
B: (laughs) I'm used to shouting. On Oxford Street, people shouted about receipts.
A: Then a physio reception would be a holiday for you. What I'd say, sorry, I'm going into advice mode, but get something on your CV, like a little admin course, because they do look at that.
B: Craig said this also. There's an online course I looked at. I just need to, erm, actually press the button.
A: Press the button! I'll be checking. Is it hard, being at home all day? I always wonder.
B: Sometimes, yes. I love him, but I miss colleagues. Just someone to talk to who isn't three.
A: I get that. I'd go mad, I think. We haven't got kids yet. It comes up a lot, especially with Dan's family, and I sort of go, yeah, yeah, at some point. I want to get my career sorted first, then maybe, you know. I don't know. Sorry, I'm talking really fast now.
B: No, it's okay. There's no right time. We waited a long time too, and people asked.
A: Did they? That actually makes me feel better. Do you get out much, London-wise? Theatre and that?
B: Before Matěj, I saw a couple of West End shows with friends. Now it's the William Morris Gallery, because it's close and free, and he can run in the garden.
A: Oh, I've seen that on Instagram, the wallpapers! I'm obsessed with interiors. I painted my living room dark green after seeing it online.
B: Yes, I saw it in your photo. It looks very nice, very tidy.
A: Ah, thank you! That's the one corner I tidied for the camera, to be fair. I'm going to London to see Wicked soon, actually, my annual West End weekend.
B: Then you can come to Walthamstow and see the wallpapers.
A: I might! Where are you from originally, Klára?
B: Brno, in Czech Republic. I came for one year, in 2014, and then I met my husband.
A: That's so romantic. One year turned into forever.
B: Yes, sort of. And now the forever has a dinosaur.
